x: Luxon, 3rd in the Hop, Step and Jump, while Ron Holtum got into the final of the 100 yds., and G.

Bare was unlucky in the High Jump, as although he cleared 5ft. 9ins., which was the height which gained 2nd place, owing to the larger number of failures, he was eventually placed 6th. Dennis Fleming was 5th in the Javelin with a throw of 164ft. 6ins., and G.

Our 7 miles Cross Country Championship for the Blackstaffe Shield was held on 12th December, and was won by Jack Brown, the holder, in the fast time of 36mins. 17secs. 2nd and 3rd places were filled by G.T.
Our team was weakened by Jack Brown's absence and it is interesting to note that G. Olding, our Second Claim member, who was beaten by Jack in the Club "7", finished 19th.
